newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to mark fasting month of Ramadan on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to mark fasting month of Ramadan on Friday.

text.p: Egypt's official Islamic legal advisory body said on Thursday that it would mark the beginning of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan on Friday.
In a televised announcement, a religious official said committees had sighted the crescent moon which signals the beginning of the Ramadan month in the Islamic calendar.
Several other countries in the Moslem world will also mark the beginning of Ramadan on Friday.
